product_overview: Bilingual real estate marketing website for Baan Ai Oun Property in Ban Bung, Chonburi. The site helps visitors browse property listings, learn about services, and submit lead forms for buying, renting, selling, partnership, training, or general contact.
core_goals: Browse available property listings and open individual property details
Filter properties by purpose, district, and price to find relevant matches
Submit buyer, owner, partner, training, and contact inquiries to the sales team
Upload property images when submitting an owner listing request
Read blog content and navigate to related properties or articles
Switch the site language between Thai and English
Use the services hub to navigate to the right lead-generation page

features.name: Language Toggle (TH/EN)
features.description: Allows visitors to switch the visible site language between Thai and English without changing the page URL.
user_flows: Open any public page -> Click the Thai language option -> See Thai content displayed on the page -> Navigate to another page -> See the selected language remain active
Open any public page -> Click the English language option -> See English content displayed on the page -> Navigate to another page -> See the selected language remain active

features.name: Smart Property Search & Filter
features.description: Lets visitors narrow down preloaded property listings using purpose, district, and maximum price filters on the home page and property listing page.
user_flows: Open the home page or property listing page -> Choose a property purpose -> Select a district -> Select a maximum price -> See the matching property cards update
Open the home page or property listing page -> Choose different filter combinations -> Observe the visible listings change to match the selected criteria
Open the home page -> Apply filters -> Select a property card -> See the corresponding property detail page
Open the home page -> Select the option to view all properties -> See the full property listing page

features.name: Property Detail View
features.description: Shows a single property with image gallery, lightbox viewing, mortgage calculator, and direct contact actions.
user_flows: Open a property detail page -> View the property photos -> Open the image gallery lightbox -> Move between images -> Close the lightbox
Open a property detail page -> Enter a purchase price -> Enter a down payment percentage -> Enter an interest rate -> Enter a loan term -> See the loan breakdown chart update immediately
Open a property detail page -> Use the direct contact action for LINE or phone -> Start a contact conversation or call

features.name: Buyer/Renter Lead Form
features.description: Collects requirement details from buyers and renters who want help finding a property.
user_flows: Open the buyer/renter lead form page -> Choose Thai buyer or foreign buyer mode -> Fill in the required contact details -> Select the property requirements -> Choose a property type -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation and reset state
Open the buyer/renter lead form page -> Leave a required field empty or enter invalid contact information -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback and submission blocked

features.name: Owner Listing Lead Form with Image Upload
features.description: Lets property owners submit listing requests with property details and up to five uploaded photos.
user_flows: Open the owner listing form page -> Choose Thai owner or foreign owner mode -> Select the intended purpose -> Choose a property type -> Fill in the listing details -> Add up to five valid images -> See image previews appear -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation and reset state
Open the owner listing form page -> Add a file with the wrong type or oversized file -> See a clear upload validation message and no file accepted
Open the owner listing form page -> Expand a FAQ item -> Read the answer -> Collapse the FAQ item

features.name: Co-Agent Application Form
features.description: Collects application details from potential co-agents or partners interested in collaborating with the business.
user_flows: Open the co-agent application page -> Fill in name, phone, and LINE ID -> Select a property type -> Enter location, price, commission, and details -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation and reset state
Open the co-agent application page -> Leave required information incomplete -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback and submission blocked

features.name: Agent Course Application Form
features.description: Collects sign-up details for the agent training course.
user_flows: Open the agent course page -> Fill in name, phone, LINE ID, and occupation -> Enter the training goal -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation and reset state
Open the agent course page -> Leave required information incomplete -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback and submission blocked

features.name: Contact Form
features.description: Provides a general contact form along with direct communication links and a map for reaching the business.
user_flows: Open the contact page -> Fill in name, phone, email, subject, and message -> Submit the form -> See a success confirmation and reset state
Open the contact page -> Leave required information empty or invalid -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback and submission blocked
Open the contact page -> Choose a direct contact option -> Start a phone call, open LINE, open WhatsApp, or start an email message
Open the contact page -> View the embedded map -> Confirm the business location

features.name: Blog Listing & Search
features.description: Displays blog posts with category filtering and live text search.
user_flows: Open the blog listing page -> Choose a category -> See only matching posts
Open the blog listing page -> Type a search term -> See the matching posts filter in real time
Open the blog listing page -> Select a blog post card -> Open the matching article page

features.name: Blog Post Detail
features.description: Shows the full blog article content and related property recommendations.
user_flows: Open a blog post page -> Read the article content -> Select a related property card -> Open the matching property detail page
Open a blog post page -> Use the LINE contact action -> Start a LINE conversation

features.name: Services Hub Navigation
features.description: Provides a central page for navigating to the main lead-generation service pages.
user_flows: Open the services page -> Select the Find Property service card -> Navigate to the buyer/renter lead form page
Open the services page -> Select the List Property service card -> Navigate to the owner listing form page
Open the services page -> Select the Co-Agent service card -> Navigate to the co-agent application page
Open the services page -> Select the Agent Course service card -> Navigate to the agent course application page

features.name: About Page
features.description: Presents the company story, milestones, and values in a static informational page.
user_flows: Open the about page -> Scroll through the milestone timeline -> Read the company values and story

known_limitations.issue: Legacy routes redirect and are unreachable
known_limitations.location: next.config.ts (redirects), src/app/(public)/buy, rent, land, owners, academy
known_limitations.impact: /buy, /rent, /land permanently redirect to /find-property; /owners redirects to /list-property; /academy redirects to /agent-course. Their page.tsx files exist but can never render, so they should be excluded from navigable test targets.

known_limitations.issue: Language toggle is client-side only, not URL-based
known_limitations.impact: TH/EN switch does not change the URL or use hreflang routing; both languages render in the DOM simultaneously and are shown/hidden via CSS + localStorage, which may affect SEO/crawler-based test assumptions.

known_limitations.issue: Lead-form endpoints are rate-limited per IP
known_limitations.impact: Repeated automated form submissions or image uploads from the same test runner IP within a short window will be rejected; test plans should avoid resubmitting the same form many times in rapid succession.
